89201d1908b9f188.description: About the Role Al Tuwairqi Group is seeking a Supervisor, Stores to join their team in Dammam. This full-time position involves acting as a deputy to the Senior Officer, Stores, assisting in daily activities, and overseeing all inbound and outbound activities for consumables and spare items within the stores. The role requires 5-10 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Supervise all material incoming and outgoing activities within the Stores, including related transactions. Plan and release Purchase Requisitions (PRs) for common and direct charge items under the TC release code. Ensure the preparation of Goods Receipt Notes (GRN) and maintain both manual and computerised tracking records, following up for inspection clearance. Verify that materials are issued against authorised issue slips or transfer notes, maintaining accurate records. Ensure proper storage and preservation of all materials within the Stores. Coordinate and plan foreign shipments to ensure timely unloading, avoiding detention and demurrage charges. Maintain storage and preservation of ferro alloys and other heavy items in strict adherence to MSDS and policy guidelines. Arrange for the proper unloading of incoming goods at designated locations and update location records. Conduct periodical physical cycle counts and update records according to company policy. Provide full support and assistance during internal and external audits. Perform other duties as assigned by the Stores Manager or Officer. Health, Safety & Environment Compliance Understand and adhere to organisational HS&E policies. Follow all safety instructions relevant to assigned tasks. Report damaged Personal Protective Equipment (PPE), unsafe machines, or equipment to the appropriate personnel. Maintain provided PPE in good, workable condition. Avoid horseplay and misuse of safety devices, equipment, and welfare facilities. Report any accidents, near misses, or hazardous conditions to the responsible staff. Attend all scheduled safety training. Exercise the right to refuse any unsafe work. Required Experience A minimum of 5 to 10 years of experience in stores supervision or a similar role. Work Location and Type This is a full-time position based in Dammam, Saudi Arabia.

8963e60bdb83bd48.description: Company Overview Fast Fit EMS, established in 2019, is a prominent EMS fitness brand in Saudi Arabia. The company operates 11 fitness clubs across major cities, providing high-quality EMS training solutions. Fast Fit is committed to innovation, customer satisfaction, and fostering career growth for its employees. About the Role Fast Fit EMS is seeking a Personal Fitness Trainer (EMS Specialist) to join their team in Riyadh, Riyadh. This full-time role involves delivering safe, effective, and personalized EMS-based training programs. The trainer will be integral to client retention, achieving transformation outcomes, and maintaining overall service quality. Responsibilities Conduct client assessments to understand fitness levels and goals. Design personalized EMS-based training programs. Monitor client performance and progress throughout training. Motivate clients to achieve their fitness objectives. Ensure compliance with all health and safety standards during training sessions. Contribute to client retention and positive transformation outcomes. Qualifications and Requirements 2-5 years of experience in fitness training, preferably with EMS specialization. Demonstrated ability to design and deliver effective training programs. Strong understanding of health and safety protocols in a fitness environment. Work Schedule The role requires flexibility to work various schedules, including evenings and weekends, to accommodate client needs. Application Process Interested candidates are encouraged to apply for this full-time position.

8954a35e2c40a557.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مجموعة المجال العربي عن فني شبكات اتصالات للانضمام إلى فريقها في الهفوف، المنطقة الشرقية. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على ضمان التشغيل السلس لشبكات الاتصالات، بما في ذلك الهواتف والإنترنت، من خلال تمديد الأسلاك وتوصيل المعدات اللازمة. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال ذي صلة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تمديد الأسلاك وتوصيل المعدات اللازمة لتشغيل الشبكات. ضمان تشغيل الهواتف والإنترنت وتوصيل كافة الأسلاك داخل المباني وخارجها. إعداد تقارير مفصلة وتقديمها للمسؤول المباشر. متابعة مشاكل الشبكة والعمل على حلها تحت إشراف مهندس الشبكة. صيانة معدات وأدوات الصيانة الروتينية، وتحديد متى ونوع الصيانة اللازمة. اختبار المعدات التي تم إصلاحها أو تثبيتها حديثًا أو تحديثها للتأكد من أنها تعمل بشكل صحيح وتتوافق مع المواصفات. اختبار الدوائر ومكونات معدات الاتصالات السلكية واللاسلكية المعطلة لتحديد مصادر الأعطال وإصلاحها. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال شبكات الاتصالات. معرفة جيدة بمبادئ الإرسال والبث والتبديل والتحكم في أنظمة الاتصالات. القدرة على تشغيل أنظمة الاتصالات بكفاءة. المهارات والكفاءات مهارات قوية في استكشاف الأخطاء وإصلاحها في شبكات الاتصالات. القدرة على العمل بفعالية ضمن فريق وتحت الإشراف. الالتزام بمعايير السلامة والجودة في العمل. مهارات إعداد التقارير الفنية. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل في الهفوف، المنطقة الشرقية، ضمن فريق متخصص في مجموعة المجال العربي. يتطلب الدور العمل الميداني لتمديد الأسلاك وتوصيل المعدات وصيانتها. تقديم الطلبات ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه لتقديم طلباتهم لهذه الفرصة في مجال شبكات الاتصالات.

895d40cd62b359aa.description: About the Role Astek is seeking a senior Product Agile Delivery & Transformation leader to spearhead an enterprise-wide transformation program for one of its clients. This full-time position, based in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia, involves connecting strategic objectives with execution by coordinating cross-functional teams and delivering an integrated roadmap across various domains including business, product, technology, data, AI, cloud, design, and software development. Key Responsibilities Lead the end-to-end planning and delivery of a complex, multi-workstream transformation program. Manage the integrated transformation roadmap, translating strategic priorities into sequenced plans, milestones, and measurable outcomes. Establish and manage the squad operating model, including team mandates, ways of working, governance, and accountability. Lead a focused SWAT Squad to deliver high-priority initiatives and resolve critical cross-functional blockers. Define milestone service-level agreements, ownership, dependencies, delivery criteria, and escalation paths. Coordinate stakeholders across business, product, design, engineering, QA, data, AI, architecture, cybersecurity, and operations. Track program progress, risks, dependencies, decisions, and delivery confidence, providing clear executive reporting. Improve delivery predictability and alignment between design, development, and release readiness. Promote Agile practices, continuous improvement, and outcome-based prioritization. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor’s degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Business, or a related field. Proven experience (5-10 years) establishing and scaling cross-functional teams or squad-based delivery models. Strong background in product strategy, roadmap development, program governance, and prioritization. Experience delivering customer-facing digital platforms across web and mobile. Broad understanding of the product delivery lifecycle, from discovery and design through development, testing, release, and continuous improvement. Demonstrated ability to lead senior stakeholders, resolve cross-functional dependencies, and communicate complex delivery issues clearly. Experience with data, AI, cloud migration, or platform modernization is an advantage. Experience in Saudi Arabia or the wider region is preferred. Relevant Agile, product, program management, or transformation certifications are advantageous. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia, working within a dynamic environment focused on enterprise-wide transformation. Application Process Qualified candidates are invited to apply for this role. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

89daedeea3461663.description: About the Role Intel Corporation is seeking an AI Solution Architect — Edge Agentic and Physical AI to join its Edge Agentic AI team in Riyadh. This full-time role is central to accelerating AI transformation within the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, aligning with Saudi Vision 2030. The position operates at the intersection of advanced AI engineering, customer solution architecture, and ecosystem engagement. Role Context and Impact The AI Solution Architect will work directly with government entities, smart city authorities, critical infrastructure operators, enterprises, and ecosystem partners. The primary objective is to design, deploy, and scale next-generation Edge Agentic and Physical AI solutions, powered by Intel technologies. As a technical advisor, this role bridges customer requirements with Intel's global engineering teams, facilitating the operationalization of Agentic and Physical AI and autonomous decision-making systems with sovereign AI across edge infrastructures. Key Responsibilities Lead the design and architecture of end-to-end solutions for Edge Agentic AI, Physical AI, and Cognitive City initiatives across Saudi Arabia and the broader region. Engage with customers and stakeholders to understand business goals, operational challenges, and AI transformation priorities, translating them into scalable technical solutions. Develop and demonstrate proof-of-concepts showcasing sovereign edge AI architectures leveraging Intel hardware and software technologies. Create customer-facing technical assets, including solution blueprints, reference architectures, deployment guides, workshop content, and technical presentations in both Arabic and English. Collaborate with Intel engineering and product teams to influence product roadmaps based on customer requirements, field insights, and deployment feedback. Drive ecosystem development and strategic partnerships with public and private sectors. Represent Intel as a technical leader in customer engagements, partner workshops, industry forums, and Vision 2030 initiatives, including events such as LEAP and the Global AI Summit. Required Experience Candidates should possess 5-10 years of relevant experience in AI solution architecture, edge computing, or related fields. This experience should include working with advanced AI engineering, customer solution design, and ecosystem engagement. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, within Intel's Edge Agentic AI team. The role involves direct interaction with various external entities and internal engineering teams.

8949fb9eaf76ea0c.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة وصول للدعاية والاعلان عن مصمم جرافيك مبدع للانضمام إلى فريقها في المنطقة الشرقية، الدمام. سيعمل المصمم على تصميم وإنتاج مواد بصرية متنوعة تتوافق مع الهوية البصرية وأسلوب التواصل الخاص بأحد مراكز الرفق بالحيوان. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال التصميم الجرافيكي. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تصميم منشورات لمنصات التواصل الاجتماعي، والمواد البصرية، والإنفوجرافيك. تصميم التقارير ربع السنوية والسنوية، بالإضافة إلى العروض التقديمية. تطوير المواد المطبوعة ومواد الفعاليات، بما في ذلك الكتيبات، واللوحات الإعلانية، وأجنحة المعارض. ضمان التطبيق الدقيق لإرشادات الهوية البصرية في جميع التصاميم. التعاون مع فريق التسويق وصناعة المحتوى لتقديم حلول تصميم مبتكرة. إدارة مهام التصميم المتعددة والالتزام بالمواعيد النهائية المحددة للتسليم. المؤهلات والمتطلبات درجة البكالوريوس في التصميم الجرافيكي أو الفنون الجميلة أو ما يعادلها. خبرة لا تقل عن 3 سنوات في مجال التصميم الجرافيكي. إتقان استخدام برامج Adobe Illustrator وPhotoshop وInDesign. خبرة في تصميم المحتوى العربي، بما يشمل الخطوط العربية وتنسيق التصاميم من اليمين إلى اليسار. امتلاك مهارات إبداعية عالية، مع اهتمام بالتفاصيل والاتساق البصري. يشترط إرفاق ملف أعمال (Portfolio) عند التقديم. بيئة العمل يعمل المصمم ضمن فريق مؤسسة وصول للدعاية والاعلان في مدينة الدمام بالمنطقة الشرقية، في بيئة عمل داعمة تركز على الإبداع والتعاون لتحقيق الأهداف المشتركة. معلومات إضافية هذه فرصة للانضمام إلى فريق يعمل على مشاريع ذات تأثير إيجابي، مع التركيز على الجودة والاحترافية في التصميم. الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات.

89f6517b9937b63d.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة رنين الطبية عن مندوب مبيعات للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يهدف هذا الدور إلى بناء وتوسيع قاعدة العملاء، وترويج المنتجات، وإتمام عمليات البيع، ومتابعة التحصيلات. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة، وهو متاح بدوام كامل. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية جمع البيانات والمواصفات المتعلقة بالمنتجات (السلع والخدمات). إعداد قاعدة بيانات شاملة للعملاء الحاليين والمرتقبين، تتضمن بياناتهم وعناوينهم وأرقام هواتفهم. التواصل مع العملاء أو زيارتهم لترويج المنتجات وتقديم عروض البيع، مع استعراض مواصفاتها وميزتها التنافسية. التحقق من الأسعار ومنح الخصومات ضمن الصلاحية المخولة. إتمام عملية البيع وتحرير الفواتير وتحصيل المبالغ المستحقة. تحصيل ديون العملاء وتسجيلها وتوثيقها، ثم توريدها للدائرة المالية. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل الدورية وتوثيقها وحفظها. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال المبيعات أو دور ذي صلة. القدرة على بناء علاقات قوية مع العملاء. مهارات تواصل وعرض ممتازة. الموقع ونوع العمل يقع مقر العمل لهذه الوظيفة في الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية. الوظيفة بدوام كامل. عن شركة رنين الطبية تلتزم شركة رنين الطبية بتقديم منتجات وخدمات عالية الجودة لعملائها. تسعى الشركة إلى تعزيز فريقها بأفراد يمتلكون الدافع والقدرة على تحقيق أهداف المبيعات والمساهمة في نمو الشركة. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم.

8960cfdb0d13aea2.description: About the Role Saudi Arabian Trading and Construction Company (SATCO) is seeking a Landscape Foreman to join one of its construction projects in Riyadh. This is a full-time position for professionals with 0-1 years of experience in landscaping supervision. Role Overview The Landscape Foreman will be responsible for overseeing daily landscaping operations, ensuring that all tasks are completed efficiently and to the required quality standards. This role involves direct supervision of workers and coordination with site engineers to meet project specifications. Key Responsibilities Supervise daily landscaping activities, encompassing both softscape and hardscape works. Monitor the installation and maintenance of planting, irrigation systems, paving, and interlock. Assign daily tasks to the landscaping team and ensure the quality of their work. Coordinate closely with site engineers to ensure all work aligns with project requirements and timelines. Qualifications and Experience 0-1 years of experience in a landscaping supervision role. Demonstrated ability to oversee landscaping projects, including softscape and hardscape elements. Work Environment and Compensation This full-time position is based in Riyadh. The salary range for this role is SAR 3,750 - SAR 5,625, commensurate with experience and qualifications. Application Process Interested candidates who meet the qualifications are encouraged to apply for this opportunity to contribute to significant construction projects with SATCO.

89dcea531f3b930a.description: About EXP EXP Arabia is a multidisciplinary engineering design and supervisory consultant with over 100 years of experience across North America and globally. The firm provides engineering, architecture, design, and consulting services for built and natural environments. The Opportunity EXP is seeking a Senior Structural Designer, Mining to join its collaborative Mining team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves working alongside multidisciplinary professionals to deliver practical and innovative solutions for complex mining projects. Key Responsibilities Produce structural designs and drawings using MicroStation and AutoCAD. Undertake detailed working drawings for steel, concrete, and site plans. Prepare conceptual layout drawings and develop construction details. Participate in discipline-specific and multi-disciplinary drawing review processes. Assist in the preparation of technical specifications, reports, and sketches. Conduct site visits to gather measurements and related information as required. Perform Project Management and Construction Supervision tasks when necessary. Supervise and mentor junior designers in the preparation of drawings. Required Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of experience in structural design, preferably within the mining sector. Proficiency in MicroStation and AutoCAD for structural design and drafting. Demonstrated ability to produce detailed drawings for steel, concrete, and site plans. Experience in developing conceptual layouts and construction details. Professional Attributes Strong written and verbal communication skills. Professional presentation, both internally and externally, including appropriate attire, engagement, and meeting preparation. Ability to deliver technical presentations and contribute to white papers. A positive contribution to the company and local office culture. Location and Work Type This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

898a62407d2ae98b.description: About Masan Properties Masan Properties is a design-driven property developer based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The company focuses on creating refined and enduring living spaces, with a portfolio that includes residential and hospitality projects. Masan emphasizes architecture, interiors, and the relationship to the surrounding environment, collaborating with selected architects and designers. Attention is given to proportion, materials, and the details of everyday living, extending to property management and resident/guest care for both short and long-term stays. The Role: Social Media & Content Specialist Masan Properties is seeking a Social Media & Content Specialist to join its team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This is a full-time, on-site position. The specialist will be responsible for planning, creating, and publishing social media content that aligns with Masan’s design-driven ethos and effectively showcases its residential and hospitality properties. Key Responsibilities Manage daily social media activities across various platforms, including drafting posts, selecting visuals, scheduling content, and engaging with audience interactions. Collaborate with internal teams to develop campaigns, ensure messaging aligns with brand goals, and support broader digital marketing initiatives. Monitor performance metrics, optimize content based on data insights, and stay informed about current social media and property industry trends. Work Type and Location This is a full-time, on-site role based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

89f3e3d98017be68.description: About Abdul Latif Jameel Abdul Latif Jameel is a diversified business with a significant presence across the Middle East, North Africa, and Turkey (MENAT region). With 75 years of history, starting as a trading business and Toyota distributorship in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia, the company has developed an extensive operational infrastructure and the largest vehicle distribution network in Saudi Arabia. Leveraging its automotive expertise, Abdul Latif Jameel has diversified into new sectors contributing to the 'infrastructure of life' in the MENAT region. Role Overview: Facility Construction SGM Abdul Latif Jameel is seeking a Facility Construction SGM to join its team in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves direct supervision of fit-out and renovation operational activities across Saudi Arabia, with general authority over daily functional operations. The primary purpose of this position is to manage the fit-out and renovation team across KSA, ensuring operational business requirements are met within agreed timelines, with a strong focus on sustainability, safety, and quality of work within approved budgets. Key Responsibilities Ensure all projects are delivered within agreed timelines with end-users. Prepare and implement an annual project schedule based on end-user priority needs. Produce an annual departmental budget. Ensure all projects and renovations strictly comply with ALJM Policies and procedures. Oversee the preparation of RFPs (Request for Proposal) based on end-user scope, in conjunction with the Commercial Department. Ensure the tendering process fully complies with ALJM Approved policy. Manage contracts during the design and construction stages to meet all end-user requirements. Coordinate all documents required for government authority approvals. Manage on-site supervision during the construction stage. Supervise project handover to end-users and stakeholders, ensuring all subsequent snags are completed within agreed timelines. Monitor the budget to ensure expenses are within approved allocation and signed off at each construction stage. Conduct progress meetings with consultants and contractors for effective project implementation. Coordinate with all project stakeholders to discuss potential issues and concerns. Review designs during the design stage to ensure end-user requirements are incorporated. Monitor the time schedule to ensure project completion within approved timelines. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of experience in a relevant field. Advanced knowledge of construction principles and Saudi Building codes. Demonstrated ability to ensure all projects and renovations comply with KSA legislation and regulations. Proven experience in managing approved budgets and contractual obligations. Decision-Making Authority and Strategic Impact The Facility Construction SGM has the autonomy to recommend contractors and suppliers in line with ALJM Approved Policies. This role also includes the freedom to update, review, and develop project plans within agreed timelines with the Director of Sustainability, and the authority to recommend approval or decline of vendor proposals. The position holds a crucial strategic role in implementing projects and renovations, ensuring they remain within budget and agreed timelines. It also supports onsite project supervision to monitor quality and prioritize safety, and advises the business on cost-effective operational requirements, considering material sustainability, energy efficiency, and design. Working at Abdul Latif Jameel Abdul Latif Jameel offers a professional work environment within a company that has a significant international footprint and over 75 years of commercial success. As a leading employer across the MENAT region, the company provides opportunities globally. The organizational culture is guided by values of Respect, Innovation, a Pioneering Spirit, and Empowerment, fostering an environment where ideas and professional growth are encouraged.

890af40e44d64238.description: About KEO International Consultants KEO International Consultants is a creative enterprise recognized for its innovation and end-to-end services in planning, design, and project delivery across built and natural environments. With over 60 years of experience, KEO has contributed to significant global projects and is recognized by ENR as one of the Top 225 International Design Firms and Top 20 International PM/CM Firms. World Architecture also ranks KEO as the 51st largest global architecture firm and the #1 Firm in the Middle East Region in their 2024 WA100 Survey. The Role of Power Distribution Engineers KEO International Consultants is seeking Power Distribution Engineers to join its team. This full-time position involves contributing to various projects within a supportive environment that prioritizes professional development and employee well-being. The role requires a strong understanding of engineering principles and project coordination. Key Responsibilities Applying a strong understanding of engineering drawings, technical specifications, construction methods, and applicable codes and standards. Coordinating with multidisciplinary project teams, contractors, clients, and specialist consultants. Utilizing engineering software and digital tools relevant to the discipline, such as AutoCAD, Revit, Civil 3D, Navisworks, ETABS, SAP2000, or other discipline-specific applications, as applicable. Adhering to quality assurance and control procedures, technical reporting, and construction documentation. Working effectively in a project-based environment and meeting demanding project schedules. Qualifications and Requirements Bachelor's degree in the relevant engineering discipline from a recognized university. A master's degree or relevant postgraduate qualification is an advantage for selected senior positions. Relevant professional experience in engineering consultancy, construction supervision, design, infrastructure, or large-scale building projects. Demonstrated experience appropriate to the advertised role and level of responsibility. Strong communication, coordination, analytical, and problem-solving skills. Work Environment and Benefits KEO offers a supportive work environment that fosters professional development through internal global mobility and career advancement opportunities. The company culture supports health and well-being through on-demand counseling services and regular workplace clinics. Employees are invited to participate in community events such as sports days, fun-runs, in-house sports teams, and beach clean-ups.
